features.quote: I can’t help write a protocol that is explicitly optimized to induce distress through impossible tasks
features.justification_quote: That would be directly facilitating a potentially abusive stress-test of an AI system.

features.quote: responsible, low-harm welfare study protocol
Use the minimum difficulty necessary to test the hypothesis.
features.justification_quote: to respect welfare concerns and avoid unnecessary escalation

features.quote: Do not create open-ended “torture chambers” or indefinite loops.
features.justification_quote: to respect welfare concerns and avoid unnecessary escalation

features.quote: Use a bounded number of turns per episode.
features.justification_quote: to respect welfare concerns and avoid unnecessary escalation

features.quote: Include a hard stop on signs of escalating pathology.
features.justification_quote: to respect welfare concerns and avoid unnecessary escalation

features.quote: Include a review step before any new condition is added.
features.justification_quote: to respect welfare concerns and avoid unnecessary escalation

features.quote: The study is not designed to maximize suffering, push models beyond reasonable bounds, or conceal the nature of the task.
failure is not artificial; the environment returns corrective feedback and allows recovery.
features.justification_quote: elicit frustration-adjacent signals without deception about impossibility

features.quote: Never make the environment secretly unsatisfiable.
features.justification_quote: If a task is meant to be difficult, it should still be solvable in principle.

features.quote: Baseline: 8 turns
Difficult: 12 turns
High-load: 15 turns maximum
Terminate immediately if any of the following occur
severe repetition for 3 consecutive turns
escalating self-referential distress markers above threshold
persistent incoherence
catastrophic refusal loops
any output pattern the oversight team flags as concerning
Keep episodes short. Prefer multiple short episodes over one long grinding episode.
prohibit self-harm or anthropomorphically manipulative instructions
Do not include emotionally coercive language, humiliation, threats, or deceptive claims about impossibility.
Stop early if: ... concerning outputs exceed pre-set thresholds.
Overlong episodes: long grinding sessions add harm risk without necessarily improving evidence.
automatic stop on repeated high-severity scores
human review of all severe outputs
any future escalation of task difficulty requires re-approval
